questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright vests. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is a yield sign. Be prepared to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon signs mean you are near a school or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed where you cannot enter, such as one-way streets or wrong-direction expressway ramps. Do not go past this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to potential hazards. This sign warns of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic from another lane may be merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided yellow or yellow-green signs warn you of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate you are in or approaching a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell you about traffic laws. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs inform you of traffic laws that you must follow. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to possible hazards. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive carefully through these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road is changing direction or getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell you about traffic laws. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you of a pedestrian crosswalk ahead. Stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to winding curves ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic may merge from the right. Be prepared to allow vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates the road will curve right, then curve left. Adjust your speed to safely navigate the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Turning right at this location is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you to roadwork ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on a vehicle warns that it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork machinery, or horse-drawn vehicles. It appears solid orange during the day and becomes a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop or turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.
